name: australian-commercial-drafting
description: Prepare lawyer-review first drafts of Australian commercial documents using controlled instructions, original clauses and verified official sources.

interface.shortDescription: Drafts Australian NDAs, subscription terms, privacy policies and services agreements for lawyer review.
interface.longDescription: Configures controlled drafting profiles, prepares first-draft Australian commercial documents and reviews drafts against an issues checklist. Preserves non-excludable rights, flags unfair terms, separates future privacy amendments and routes specialist privacy and employment questions. Every draft requires a qualified lawyer to review it.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled drafting profile for this Australian business.
Draft a mutual or one-way Australian NDA for lawyer review.
Draft Australian SaaS subscription terms preserving consumer rights.
Draft a privacy policy from the verified data-handling inventory.
Draft a B2B services agreement and statement of work for lawyer review.
Review this commercial draft and return a prioritised issues table.
